content:
Integrate the uploaded JS files and ensure all interactive elements work.

1. Review js/*.js (the uploaded scripts) — understand what each one does
2. Include them in the appropriate pages via <script src="js/..."> (relative paths!)
3. Test each interactive element with Playwright:
   - Click every button (data-testid='*-btn')
   - Open every dropdown/menu/accordion
   - Submit every form (with valid + invalid data)
   - Test mobile menu toggle if exists
4. Fix any JS errors that appear in console
5. Verify Alpine.js bindings work (x-data, x-show, etc.) if used

Verification:
1. Playwright: walk through every page, exercise every interactive element
2. Screenshot before/after each interaction
3. Console errors array MUST be empty
4. No CSS contrast issues (check with hover states)
